trigger: Cold start has no network and no authorized durable cache
expected_ui: Full-screen offline state with concise cause and no stale success claim
data_policy: Use deterministic fixtures in tests; never invent live data
permission_policy: Apply the destination route permission before retry
notes: Rescue has no across-restart offline cache

trigger: A request fails because transport or server is unavailable
expected_ui: Inline or full-page error keeps prior safe context and exposes retry
secondary_action: Dismiss when prior content remains usable
data_policy: Retain only data permitted by the owning module
permission_policy: Do not bypass auth or owner checks during retry
notes: Failure fingerprint must be deterministic in tests

trigger: A route or refresh is awaiting data
expected_ui: Skeleton matches final geometry without fake labels or interactive controls
data_policy: Use fixed seed and disabled animation for golden evidence
permission_policy: Loading must not reveal unauthorized prior-session content
notes: Respect reduced motion and accessibility semantics

trigger: Authenticated account has zero pets
expected_ui: Empty state explains first-pet value and exposes one clear add action
data_policy: No fixture pet may appear in runtime
permission_policy: Authenticated account owner only
notes: Primary action routes to /pets/create

trigger: Enabled browse returns an empty first page for the active filter
expected_ui: Honest empty-nearby state shows the active area and does not claim a total count
data_policy: No durable Rescue cache; use sanitized in-memory page only
permission_policy: Public API data may still be behind the authenticated mobile route
notes: When browse is false show staged state instead of this empty state

trigger: Vet query succeeds with zero matching clinics
expected_ui: No-results state keeps query and filters visible
data_policy: Keep deterministic public clinic search state
permission_policy: Location permission remains optional
notes: Map action restores the VET branch root

trigger: Valid credentials produce a verified session
expected_ui: Accessible success acknowledgement precedes safe returnTo or Home navigation
data_policy: Clear sensitive form fields after session establishment
permission_policy: Protected destination requires the established session
notes: Do not expose credentials in logs or evidence

trigger: Login is rejected or fails
expected_ui: Form remains populated only with safe fields and announces the error
data_policy: Never retain or log password
permission_policy: Guest policy remains in force
notes: Focus moves to summary or first invalid field

trigger: Registration creates a pending verification record
expected_ui: Success acknowledgement routes to OTP with required safe parameters
data_policy: Do not log password or raw verification secret
permission_policy: Account is not treated as active before verification
notes: Preserve safe returnTo

trigger: Validation conflict or server error rejects registration
expected_ui: Form remains editable and announces field or server error
data_policy: Never persist or log password
permission_policy: Guest policy remains in force
notes: Duplicate account error must be actionable

trigger: An authorized create or update succeeds
expected_ui: Success state names the saved object and updates every visible dependent summary
secondary_action: Undo only where a real contract exists
data_policy: Refresh from authoritative repository result
permission_policy: Backend authorization remains authoritative
notes: Applies only to implemented writes

trigger: An authorized create or update fails
expected_ui: Edited data remains available and an accessible error explains the next action
data_policy: Keep only the minimum safe draft allowed by the module
permission_policy: Do not convert a permission failure into apparent success
notes: No optimistic success without confirmation

trigger: Publish fails after Day 40 create is enabled
expected_ui: Draft remains editable and failure distinguishes validation conflict and transport causes
data_policy: Private location and contact never enter evidence
permission_policy: Owner authorization and backend version checks are mandatory
notes: Canonical route supersedes inventory historical draftId alias

trigger: Location is denied restricted or not determined

permission_policy: Permission denial must not bypass route authorization
notes: Test denied permanently-denied and approximate-location paths

trigger: Selected media fails validation upload or processing

data_policy: Do not log storage keys hashes or private EXIF
permission_policy: Only the authorized owner may attach private media
notes: Fixtures must never be bundled into production

permission_policy: Guest verification rate limits remain enforced
notes: Clock and timezone are frozen in tests
